$doc: Campaign controller — the single spec sheet ops edits to retune the program. The engine and frontend both read this file. Env vars still hold the SECURITY gates (MEGAPOT_ACTIVE, MEGAPOT_WHITELIST, keys) — this file holds the PRODUCT parameters.

campaign.name: Megapot Rewards - Season 1
campaign.$note: network testnet = Base Sepolia accrual for internal testing; flip to mainnet after sign-off. start/end are hard bounds — fills outside the window never credit.

eligibility.$products: product suites this campaign covers: perps (native HL coins) | xyz-equities (coins prefixed xyz:) | baskets (fills recorded via thesis executions — needs app stitch) | predictions (not yet supported)
eligibility.$symbols: qualifying tickers — edit freely between runs; empty array = all symbols on the enabled products
eligibility.$excludeZeroFeePairs: symbols currently running zero-fee promos (no fee revenue → no credit), e.g. the xyz rebate campaign list

economics.$note: 4.0bps = Hence's LIVE builder-fee take (verified /api/config hlBuilderFee=40 tenths). Charged on routed orders regardless of maker/taker, so accrual is identical on maker flow. Ticket conversion always uses Megapot's live ticketPrice().

levels.requires: Base rate - every qualifying trade counts.

multipliers.$note: volumeFactor = share of base volume needed per ticket at that tier (0.50 = half the volume). Engine applies 1x until basket signals are stitched from the app - tier REQUIREMENTS are placeholders for Sarthak to set.

firstTradeBonus.$note: activation grant: account + email + first qualifying trade of >= minTradeUsd opens the pack; season-wide pool of 200 tickets, first come. At most dailyMintCap activation tickets mint per UTC day across ALL users; later activations defer to the next day.

terms.title: Megapot Rewards - Season 1 rules
steps: Create your Hence account and link a real email.
Place your first qualifying trade of $250 or more - it opens a 1-5 ticket pack (season pool: 200 tickets).
Keep trading: 4.0bps of qualifying volume becomes reward credit, maker or taker.
Streak bonus: trade 3 days with $1,000 cumulative volume for +1 ticket; 5 days and $5,000 for another (20-ticket pool).
Run thesis baskets to climb tiers - up to 5x, cutting the volume per ticket in half.
Tickets mint to YOUR wallet. Megapot draws daily - match numbers to win tiered prizes.

actions.reward: tiers 2x-5x: mint on 90% down to 50% of the volume

terms.caps: Up to 5 tickets minted per day and 15 per week per wallet. Earned tickets beyond the caps queue and mint at the daily pace. Activation packs mint at most 30 tickets per day across all users - later activations mint the next day.
disclosures: Tickets are entries in Megapot's daily draw. Winning is chance-based; there is no guaranteed prize.
Tickets mint non-custodially to your own wallet on Base. Hence never holds your tickets or winnings.
Prizes, odds, draw mechanics and claims are operated by Megapot under Megapot's terms.
Reward credit has no cash value and converts only to tickets at Megapot's live ticket price.
Multiplier tiers (2x-5x) activate as basket tracking goes live this season; until then the base rate applies.
Availability subject to eligibility and jurisdiction. Parameters may be retuned between seasons.

assetTable.note: Volume shown mints ONE ticket at the base 1x tier (4.0bps of volume at the $1 live ticket price). Maker or taker - same accrual. Higher tiers cut the volume needed by their factor.

streak.$note: trade-day streak within the week: at day N with >= min cumulative qualifying volume, +tickets once per week; shared 20-ticket season pool.
